zipcode.description: Postal code. Required whenever the country referenced by `countryId` has `postalCodeRequired` enabled, which is the case for every country on a default installation.

accountType.description: Type of the customer account, `private` or `business`. Only evaluated when the `core.loginRegistration.showAccountTypeSelection` setting is enabled, and then it makes `company` required. It is not stored on the address, and during registration the account type of the customer is taken from the top level of the request instead.

company.description: Company of the address. Required when the address is sent with `accountType` set to `business` and the account type selection is enabled.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number. Required when the `core.loginRegistration.showPhoneNumberField` and `core.loginRegistration.phoneNumberFieldRequired` settings are both enabled. Both are off by default.

additionalAddressLine1.description: Required when the `core.loginRegistration.showAdditionalAddressField1` and `core.loginRegistration.additionalAddressField1Required` settings are both enabled. Both are off by default.

additionalAddressLine2.description: Required when the `core.loginRegistration.showAdditionalAddressField2` and `core.loginRegistration.additionalAddressField2Required` settings are both enabled. Both are off by default.
